LanguageData.BOR_QuantumForging.label: quantum forging speed
LanguageData.BOR_QuantumForging.description: The speed at which this character can forge Neutronium into various materials and goods using a Sunforge. This complex process demands steady manipulation for precise quantum state transitions, mental consciousness to maintain the quantum coherence field, keen sight to monitor the transmutation process, and deep knowledge of crafting and science to convert atoms into specific materials.
LanguageData.BOR_BionicCraftingSpeed.label: bionic crafting speed
LanguageData.BOR_BionicCraftingSpeed.description: The speed at which this character can assemble and integrate advanced bionics. This intricate work requires mastery of crafting techniques for assembling precision components, intellectual understanding of neural and mechanical interfaces, and medical knowledge to ensure biocompatibility with living tissue.
